about: Retired or shut-down services in resources/apis.json, each with the provider's own notice. scripts/api-install.mjs copies an entry into the matching record's lifecycle field; a retired API then gets a migration pointer instead of install steps and ranks below live APIs. resourceIds marks catalog packages that only wrap the same service: discovery shows them with the same pointer and ranks them below live ones. Add an entry only with a primary-source notice.

groups.replacement: Microsoft points to Grounding with Bing Search in Azure AI Agents; for plain web search results use another search API
use platform deep links (Android App Links, iOS Universal Links) or another link service, per the Firebase migration FAQ
use Google Sign-In for authentication and the Google People API for profile data
Google points to the open-source Snapshot Debugger, archived in September 2023 and unmaintained
